rule: Fallback weekly calorie target = bodyweight x 33 kcal/kg/day x 7, used only when there's no MacroFactor target or saved weekly target
summary: The ISSN gives ~25-35 kcal/kg/day for general fitness (30-40 min, 3x/week) and 40-70 for athletes doing 2-3+ h/day, with a minimum of 27-30 kcal/kg for all exercisers. 33 is therefore low by textbook ranges for a hybrid athlete. It does match this athlete's measured MacroFactor maintenance (2834 kcal, ~31.5 kcal/kg), so it is calibrated to him, not to a population. It only applies when there is no MacroFactor or saved target. Treat it as a placeholder; if it's ever used across a run-heavy block, check the EA flag (at 33 kcal/kg, EA is close to 30 once ~600 kcal of exercise is subtracted).

sources.note: ISSN 2018: general fitness 25-35 kcal/kg/day; moderate-to-high-volume athletes 40-70 kcal/kg/day; minimum 27-30 kcal/kg
Endurance athletes' total energy expenditure varies across the training season; intake often lags expenditure
